# gezor_kms_default_key (Resource)

The workspace's default encryption key. Destroying it only removes it from Terraform state.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "gezor_kms_default_key" "this" {
  key_id = gezor_kms_key.lake.id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `key_id` (String) Key id to use by default.

### Optional

- `workspace` (String) Workspace id or slug. Defaults to the provider's `workspace`. Changing it recreates the resource.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Always `default`.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Append @<workspace> to import from a workspace other than the provider default.
terraform import gezor_kms_default_key.example default
```
